I did not derive this from first principles. It recalls a result from the literature on defective chromatic polynomials of trees, which I believe states that the family $\{\chi_d(T;k)\}_{d\ge 0}$ determines the counts $N(P_j,T)$ for $j \le 4$ but not for $j = 5$. I'm not fully certain of this recollection, so treat the value as a best estimate rather than a verified result.

ANSWER: 4
